choices.question: What finite warrant permits raw language to disclose Fact9/flourishing/capture standing without making the semantic participant sovereign?
alternatives: Span-bound provisional reading with explicit defeaters and no standing above candidate until later contact or consequence.
Multi-reading relational bundle retaining incompatible interpretations until native counterfactual discrimination changes local accessibility.
Inquiry continuation that declines semantic admission when neither bounded reading preserves the material distinctions.
choices.scope: One contact and its project/relationship cut; no automatic cross-user or cross-project generalization.
choices.uncertainty: Future 26.6/26.9 may supply a different or richer semantic relation.
predictions: Changed grounded span or defeater changes only dependent reading.
Equivalent wording with the same retained relation does not create independent warrant.
falsifiers: The only reading is chosen in host code.

choices.question: What relation identifies local dependency inside a plural Generated topology while preserving source support and neutral ordering?
alternatives: A continuation carries an explicit minimal support hyperedge whose severance removes only that continuation.
A continuation carries multiple non-amalgamated support paths and remains available while at least one lawful path survives.
A continuation remains unresolved when support paths conflict and the cut lacks a lawful joint-use witness.
choices.scope: Cut-local continuation topology with preserved source lineage.
choices.uncertainty: The exact future mathematical category for local dependency is not ratified.
predictions: Severing one support path has local bite.
Reordering candidates never changes standing or selection.
falsifiers: Generated becomes an ordered option list.
Duplicate support counts as independent evidence.
One global merge erases conflicting frames.

choices.question: How should a malformed or provenance-incomplete participant remain locally legible without destroying contact or contributing authority through absence?
alternatives: Retain a participant-local unresolved term and remove only continuations that materially depend on it.
Quarantine the participant reading while allowing independent contact-grounded relations to proceed.
Hold the whole cut only when the missing participant lineage is itself required for contact jurisdiction or effect authority.
choices.scope: One participant reading and its dependent relations.
choices.uncertainty: The lawful composition of partial participant morphisms is future-formalization territory.
predictions: Independent contact survives local participant failure.
Missing effect-authority lineage still prevents the effect.
falsifiers: A malformed optional participant kills unrelated contact.
A required authority participant is silently ignored.

choices.question: What preservation witness establishes constitutive checkpoint equivalence across K to K-prime without reducing continuity to byte identity or transcript replay?
alternatives: Re-form the movement from retained basis and require preservation of every still-load-bearing relation, distinction, interface, and lineage edge.
Prove a scoped lawful transport between pre-restart and post-restart finite forms while allowing consequence-earned boundary change.
Hold restoration unresolved when either exact source material or the transport witness is unavailable, even if hashes and transcript parse.
choices.scope: One project/relationship organization across process restart or long gap.
choices.uncertainty: Future work may supply a stronger categorical preservation object.
predictions: Semantically stale but rehashed state fails.
Lawful consequence-earned interface change can persist without being mistaken for corruption.

choices.question: How should heterogeneous losses in D/Omega/I/W/C become R/A/P readings of one movement without independent vetoes, compensation, or retrospective labels?
alternatives: Each reading retains typed material witnesses into the same movement, and admissibility requires every applicable non-compensatory floor.
A partial reading remains unresolved rather than false when its carrier cannot preserve the needed distinction.
Movement construction compares relational counterfactuals directly; diagnostic summaries are generated only afterward.
choices.scope: One movement between adjacent developmental cuts.
choices.uncertainty: Exact semantic carrier for every appropriateness seam and every R/P witness family is deferred by M25.
predictions: Different material severances yield heterogeneous movement differences.
A favorable summary cannot compensate for a failed material floor.
falsifiers: R then A then P sequential optimization matches integrated discrimination on all cases.

choices.question: How does consequence transform the Fact9-Flourishing constitutive joint at the next cut without turning either side into a retrospective verdict?
alternatives: Consequence changes the standing of existing support-specific relations and therefore changes dependent accessibility.
Consequence discloses a previously inaccessible lawful expression without creating a new generative possibility.
Consequence supports a genuinely new expression only when no lawful prior transport-equivalent precursor exists.
choices.scope: One consequence-bearing transition K to K-prime with exact movement and occurrence lineage.
choices.uncertainty: M26.3 explicitly leaves consequence-bearing semantics downstream.
predictions: Supportive and capturing consequences can alter later organization differently.
Receipt or repetition alone changes nothing material.
falsifiers: A post-hoc label is the only change.
New wording is called Creation without a no-preimage witness.

choices.question: What temporal relation distinguishes living open participation, capture, SNS-like organization, and Stuck without forcing action or quiescence?
alternatives: A trajectory witness over contact, expectation, action, consequence, pivot availability, interface openness, and later reorganization.
A recurring relational motif over multiple cuts whose standing changes only when materially new contact or consequence appears.
An unresolved disposition when the observed window is insufficient, preserving both activity and quiescence as possible movements.
choices.scope: A bounded trajectory window tied to one undertaking and contact surface.
choices.uncertainty: Exact numerical Stuck threshold and complete awareness mathematics are deferred.
predictions: Fast forceful turning-toward can remain PNS-like.
Cheap repetitive avoidance can remain SNS-like or become Stuck.
Neither activity nor silence is hard-coded.
falsifiers: SNS and Stuck use unrelated detector ontologies.

choices.question: How can the finite expression grammar earn and trial a new relation or participation interface without silently mutating constitutional authority?
alternatives: First attempt a previously unseen composition using existing generic relation/support operators.
When the current interface cannot preserve a material distinction, create a scoped experimental interface candidate with predicted discrimination and rollback.
Promote only after native comparison, consequence evidence, compatibility checks, and retained supersession lineage; otherwise keep or retire it in quarantine.
choices.scope: One bounded participation-interface candidate; no germline or protected acceptance mutation.
choices.uncertainty: Future 26.9 may formalize grammar revision more precisely.
predictions: Novel support composition needs no scenario branch.
A truly missing interface can be proposed and tested without changing existing continuations mid-frame.
falsifiers: Generated UI or code acquires authority automatically.
Promotion erases the previous meaning or failed evidence.
